Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Yeah, we can’t believe it either. Secret Lair is commemorating the tragic death of Planeswalker, task mage, and flame grandma Jaya Ballard during the story events of Dominaria United. As a celebration of her life, we’ve assembled an all-Jaya drop for your deck or collection that we think she would approve of: with fire, fire everywhere. So here’s a toast to the fallen pyromancer—we'll make it extra scorched.

Contents:
• 1x Foil Jaya Ballard
• 1x Foil Jaya’s Immolating Inferno
• 1x Foil Pyretic Ritual
• 1x Foil Repercussion
• 1x Foil Pyromancer’s Goggles
